shared_elements: row of repeated identical motifs aligned side by side
triangular/chevron forms filled with fine parallel hatching
low-relief schematic forms with linear interior hatching
band of small repeated units running along the top of a register
justification: Both surfaces organise their content into horizontal registers separated by a plain raised band, and both include a row of identical repeated units capped by hatched triangular elements, rendered in flat low relief with fine parallel-line infill — a fairly specific shared decorative habit. The decisive difference is subject matter: A is a figural composition with a large profile quadruped, small human-like figure, birds and a row of crouching animals, while B contains no creatures at all, only an abstract file of repeated ribbed forms.
